status.nb: 21 væpnede hendelser meldt de siste sju dagene, 25 prosent færre enn uken før, flest i Damaskus, Quneitra og Golanhøydene.

summary.en: Syrian security forces killed two of their own personnel during an operation against an ISIS-linked cell near Damascus and the Lebanese border. Israeli forces conducted a raid in southern Syria that killed a Syrian man with Down syndrome in Daraa. Jordan and Syria met to stress territorial integrity and reject Israeli attacks on southern Syria while discussing strategic projects. Returnees from the Sare Kani area reported difficulties reclaiming property as security forces increase evictions. The conflict has caused 2,732 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Syriske sikkerhetsstyrker drepte to av sine egne personell under en operasjon mot en IS-tilknyttet celle nær Damaskus og den libanesiske grensen. Israelske styrker gjennomførte et raid i sørlige Syria som drepte en syrisk mann med Down-syndrom i Daraa. Jordan og Syria møttes for å understreke territoriell integritet og avvise israelske angrep på sørlige Syria, samtidig som de diskuterte strategiske prosjekter. Tilbakevendere fra Sare Kani-området rapporterte vanskeligheter med å gjenvinne eiendom mens sikkerhetsstyrkene øker utkastelser. Konflikten har forårsaket 2 732 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Aftermath of the Syrian civil war
background.extract: Disputes and clashes in Syria have continued following the fall of the Assad regime in December 2024, which many sources consider the end of the Syrian civil war. Numerous actors are involved, including clashes between the newly-formed Syrian caretaker government and later the Syrian transitional government led by the former emir of Hay'at Tahrir al-Sham (HTS) and incumbent president Ahmed al-Sharaa, Assad loyalists, Alawite groups, and Druze insurgents; clashes between elements of the Turkish-backed Syrian National Army (SNA) and the government on one side, and formerly the Kurdish-led Syrian Democratic Forces (SDF) on the other; as well as an Israeli invasion and occupation of the demilitarized buffer zone in southwestern Syria.
